vlae.teks: 'n Karavaan is 'n groep handelaars, diere en goedere wat saam op reis is.
vlae.rede: The study block 'Die pad na Asië' describes a caravan as 'n groep handelaars en diere wat saam op pad was' (no goods), while the glossary entry adds 'goedere'; the two descriptions differ in content, so a language agent should not reconcile them, but the writer may want to make them match.
